|-|Trivia=
*Most of the names of the achievements are player suggestions from the [https://steamcommunity.com/app/218620/discussions/10/154645497345310070/ Do you know what would be a great name for an achievement?] thread.
*'''Hello To You, My New Friends''' is a quote from [[Vernon Locke|Locke]] in [[Beneath the Mountain]], stated when the players zipline up the elevator shaft and meet Locke in person.
*'''Locke & Load''' is a pun on the phrase "lock and load" and Locke, as well as being the name of the Beneath the Mountain heist's default soundtrack and the name of the community event the achievement was released in.
*'''Drain the Swamp''' is a {{w|Drain the swamp|phrase}} used by American politicians, alluding to the historical draining of swamps to keep {{w|mosquito}} populations low to combat {{w|malaria}}. The phrase being attributed to Locke may indicate it is a reference to {{w|Jessica Stern}} who, in the article "Preparing for a War on Terrorism", calls on the U.S. to use foreign aid and soft power to combat ("drain") terrorism in failing/failed polities ("the swamps").
*'''FUBAR''' is military slang for "fucked up beyond all recognition/any repair".
*'''By Air, Land, and Sea''' refers to a quote from {{w|Winston Churchill}}, from the end of his "{{w|We shall fight on the beaches}}" speech.
*'''Madman Absolution''' is a reference to ''{{w|Hitman: Absolution}}''.
*'''Best Use of a Farm Animal''' was a category of the [https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards/2016/ 2016 Steam Awards].
*'''Golf Oscar Alpha Tango Sierra''' is "goats" in the {{w|NATO phonetic alphabet}}.
*'''All I Want for Christmas is You''' is a reference to "{{w|All I Want for Christmas Is You}}" by {{w|Mariah Carey}}.
*'''How the Winch Stole Christmas''' is a pun on ''{{w|How the Grinch Stole Christmas!}}'' and "winch", which the players use in the heist to airlift the Christmas tree and escape.
*'''The Princess is in Another Safe!''' is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/but-our-princess-is-in-another-castle But Our Princess is in Another Castle] meme that originated from ''{{w|Super Mario Bros.}}''
*'''Play Rough''' is from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a_z4IuxAqpE speech] in the final scene of ''{{w|Scarface (1983 film)|Scarface}}''.
*'''The World is Yours''' is the tagline of the {{w|Scarface: The World Is Yours|''Scarface'' video game}}.
*'''Reminds Me of Myself Back in the Day!''' is a quote from [[Bain]] played when the crew survives an [[Assault Waves|assault wave]].
*'''A Bridge Too Far!''' is an [[Achievements|achievement]] from ''[[PAYDAY: The Heist]]''.
*'''Washington City Marathon''' is not an accurate title, as [[Heat Street (Payday 2)|Heat Street]] takes place in {{w|New York City}}, rather than {{w|Washington D.C.}} as most of the rest of the heists in the game do.
*'''Keep Calm and Carry On... Shooting''' is a reference to the {{w|Keep Calm and Carry On}} British {{w|motivational poster}} made in preparation of {{w|World War II}}, which saw [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/keep-calm-and-carry-on a revival] 70 years later.
*Most of [[Charon|the Continental]] achievements are quotes from the ''{{w|John Wick}}'' film.
**'''Baba Yaga''' is what the Russian mafia Wick fights throughout the film codenames him.
*'''The Big Bank Theory''' is a pun on the {{w|Big Bang|Big Bang theory}}.
*'''Dead Man's Hand''' is a {{w|Dead man's hand|poker hand}} that is said to have been held by {{w|Wild Bill Hickok}} when he was murdered. It is also the name of the soundtrack for the heist.
*'''Prankcall''' is the [[w:c:hotlinemiami:Prank Call|name of a level]] in ''{{w|Hotline Miami}}''.
*'''Running in the 80's''' is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/max-coveri-running-in-the-90s memetic song] "Running in the 90's" made by {{w|Maurizio De Jorio}} under the alias of Max Coveri.
*'''Diesel is My Juice''' may be a reference to ''PAYDAY 2'' running on the {{w|Diesel (game engine)|Diesel engine}}.
*'''Sons of Robbery''' is a reference to ''{{w|Sons of Anarchy}}'', in which [[Rust]]'s actor, {{w|Ron Perlman}}, played as {{w|Clay Morrow}}.
*'''And Now for Something Completely Different''' is a reference to ''{{w|Monty Python's Flying Circus}}'', which would often use the line to open sketches, and is also the title of the {{w|And Now for Something Completely Different|1971 film}} that contained sketches from the first two seasons of ''Flying Circus'', intended for American audiences that had not seen the series.
*'''Itsy Bitsy Heisters Cooking Meth All Night Long''' is a reference to the {{w|Itsy Bitsy Spider}} nursery rhyme.
*'''Bain, I Shrunk the Heisters''' is a reference to ''{{w|Honey, I Shrunk the Kids}}''. A similar play on words was used as the tagline for the [[Lab Rats]] heist when it was released.
*'''Jailhouse Rock''' refers to either {{w|Jailhouse Rock (song)|the song of the same name}} by {{w|Elvis Presley}} and/or the {{w|Jailhouse Rock (film)|musical drama film}} for which the song was composed.
*'''¡La Victoria es Nuestra!''' is Spanish for "victory is ours".
*'''Plata o Plomo''' is a Colombian Spanish slang phrase that translates to "silver (money) or lead (bullets)", meaning "accept the bribe or lose your life".
*'''Hector's Heroes''' may be a reference to the American TV sitcom ''{{w|Hogan's Heroes}}''.
*'''Cooking for Dummies''' and '''Bank Robbery for Dummies''' are references to the ''{{w|For Dummies}}'' books.
*'''Alright Boys n Girls''' and '''This is Fucking War Baby!''' are quotes from [[Jimmy]].
*'''All Your Bass Are Belong To Us''' is a reference to a {{w|All your base are belong to us|meme}} that originated from ''{{w|Zero Wing}}''.
*'''Eat, Sleep, Heist, Repeat''' is likely a reference to the song "{{w|Eat, Sleep, Rave, Repeat}}" by {{w|Fatboy Slim}}.
*'''Forte to Fortissimo''' are {{w|Dynamics (music)|music dynamics terms}} meaning "loud" and "very loud".
*'''Veni, Saw, Vici''' is wordplay with the phrase ''{{w|Veni, vidi, vici}}'', which means "I came, ''I saw,'' I conquered".
*'''A Diamond Dozen''' is a pun on "a dime a dozen".
*'''Go, Go, Go''', '''pd_bank''', and '''Clutch''' are all references to ''{{w|Counter-Strike}}''.
*'''Making My Way Downtown''' is a reference to {{w|Vanessa Carlton}}'s debut single "{{w|A Thousand Miles}}".
*'''Heisty McHeistface''' is a reference to ''{{w|Boaty McBoatface}}''.
*'''The Little Heister That Could''' is a reference to ''{{w|The Little Engine That Could}}''.
*'''Modern Train Robbers''' was the name of the removed achievement for completing [[Transport: Train Heist|Train Heist]] on Death Wish.
</tabber>
